details: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller stated on September 3, 2026, that he would be inclined to support holding interest rates at their current levels, provided that upcoming August inflation data is favorable. This announcement caused a significant shift in market expectations, with the probability of a September rate hike falling to around 50.4% from 63.2% a day earlier. His remarks suggest a less aggressive stance on monetary policy if inflation continues to show signs of cooling. The August jobs report (due September 4) and CPI data (due September 11) are critical for the Fed's next decision.
sourceName: Federal Reserve Board (Speech) / Quartz (reporting on Waller's remarks)
title: Fed's Waller Leans Towards Holding Rates Steady if Inflation Cooperates

details: On September 3, 2026, Bitcoin's price climbed 5.5% to $81,491, marking its first close above $80,000 in September. This rally was largely attributed to a pause in hostilities between the U.S. and Iran, which temporarily alleviated risk-off sentiment, and the reduced likelihood of a Federal Reserve rate hike following Governor Waller's comments. The broader crypto market also saw a 4.7% gain. Traders who had bet on Bitcoin falling were forced to buy back, liquidating $164 million of short positions.

details: Geopolitical tensions, specifically the escalated conflict between the U.S. and Iran, have pushed Brent crude oil prices above $95 per barrel and WTI crude futures above $91 per barrel. Higher energy costs are stoking inflation concerns, which typically leads to expectations of tighter financial conditions and higher bond yields. This dynamic generally weighs on risk assets, including cryptocurrencies, by diverting capital towards safer, yield-bearing investments.
sourceName: Wall Street Journal (as reported by Quartz) / KuCoin
title: Oil Prices Climb on US-Iran Tensions, Heightening Inflation Worries

details: The August US jobs report, scheduled for release on September 4, 2026, and the August Consumer Price Index (CPI) data, due on September 11, 2026, are critical macroeconomic events. These reports will significantly influence the Federal Reserve's monetary policy decisions at its September 15-16 meeting. A softer labor market or cooling inflation could reinforce the case for holding interest rates steady, while strong economic data might lead to renewed calls for tightening.
title: Key US Economic Reports This Week to Shape Federal Reserve's Rate Decision

details: A substantial unlock of Hyperliquid's HYPE tokens, estimated to be worth approximately $797 million, is scheduled for September 6, 2026. These tokens are allocated to core contributors. While historical data suggests that not all projected unlocks immediately enter circulation, such events increase the circulating supply, which can exert downward pressure on the token's price. Other tokens like SUI, OPN, and ZRO also face unlocks in September.
